events.desc: Our biggest annual gathering — colours, food, folk music and a reunion with the extended parivar.
events.details: Join us for the most vibrant celebration of the year! Holi Milan 2026 brings together 500+ families from across the NCR for a day of colours, music, dance, and togetherness. The event features live dhol, folk performances from Hardoi artists, organic colours, food stalls serving traditional Awadhi cuisine, and a dedicated kids' zone. Every member is welcome to invite extended family. Registration is mandatory for headcount and safety planning.

events.desc: Members from tech, finance and civil services — informal evening, introductions and mentorship.
events.venue: The Social House, Cyber Hub, Gurgaon
events.details: An evening designed for career growth and community bonding. Whether you are a seasoned professional, a fresh graduate, or an entrepreneur — this meetup connects you with fellow Hardoi families working across industries. Expect short talks, open-mic introductions, mentorship pairing, and plenty of networking over chai and snacks. Dress code is smart casual.

events.desc: Crafts, food stalls from Hardoi, children's activities and a community dinner.
events.details: Diwali Mela is where the entire parivar comes together to celebrate the festival of lights. The mela features handcrafted diyas and decorations from Hardoi artisans, traditional food stalls, rangoli competitions, a children's fancy-dress event, live music, and a grand community dinner. The event concludes with an eco-friendly fireworks display. Every family is encouraged to set up a stall or volunteer.

events.desc: Free check-ups, medicines and doctor consultations organised back in our home district.
events.details: Giving back to our roots. The annual Health Camp in Hardoi provides free medical check-ups, medicines, and specialist consultations to 400+ villagers. Our volunteer doctors from NCR — general physicians, eye specialists, and dental surgeons — travel to Hardoi for a full-day camp. We also distribute hygiene kits and conduct health awareness sessions. Volunteers from NCR are welcome to join and help with logistics and coordination.

events.desc: Inter-city friendly tournament — six teams, one trophy, plenty of chai.
events.details: The Parivar Cricket Cup is the most awaited sporting event of the year. Six teams representing Noida, Delhi, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, and Hardoi compete in a T-20 format tournament. The day includes opening ceremony, league matches, semi-finals, and the grand final. Families are encouraged to come and cheer. Food stalls, commentary, and trophies make it a complete experience. Player registrations close two weeks before the event.

Mark your calendars: Professionals Meetup on April 22 at Gurgaon. Whether you're in tech, finance, civil services or starting your own venture — come meet the parivar network. Link in bio.

timeline.t: A few families, one WhatsApp group
timeline.d: Founded by six Hardoi families in Noida, initially to celebrate Holi together away from home.
We grew from a group chat to an annual festival drawing 300+ attendees across NCR.
Organised oxygen, medicine and meal support for members and families back in Hardoi.
We crossed a thousand verified members and added scholarship and health programmes.
